insight: Rebranded from Grid.ai in 2022 alongside a $40M Series B led by Coatue; founded by PyTorch Lightning creator William Falcon.
name: Lightning AI
tagline: Persistent GPU cloud workspaces to build, train, and ship AI.
description: A cloud platform built around AI Studios — collaborative, persistent GPU workspaces for coding, training models, running inference, and building agents and AI apps. Pay-as-you-go GPUs with a monthly free credit allowance, plus a Pro tier and bring-your-own-cloud for enterprise. Made by the team behind the open-source PyTorch Lightning framework.

modelSupport.notes: General-purpose GPU compute — train or serve any framework/model.

edge: From the PyTorch Lightning team — Studios are persistent GPU workspaces you pause and resume, not throwaway notebooks.
cons: Less raw control than bare cloud
